corrections.v1: Intact-energy failures had their samples re-timed, not lost; identical samples would give identical decoder input
corrections.corrected: Matching total energy does not establish sample-for-sample fidelity, sample order, timing integrity or identical decoder input; captured PCM was not retained or compared.
An approximately 2% energy deficit is consistent with partial loss, attenuation or clipping; it does not measure the fraction of speech samples lost.
Clean-fixture decoder runs establish results only for those tested inputs; decoder or application issues on actual captured PCM are not ruled out.

corrections.v1: The app records exactly what the HAL delivers
corrections.corrected: Captured total energy shows no net amplitude loss at that layer, not sample-level fidelity.

corrections.v1: Failing layer: the emulator virtual sound device
corrections.corrected: Evidence-supported localization: observed HAL I/O errors and silence insertions coincide with every failing sdk1 capture and neither pass and strongly implicate the emulator audio path; the root cause is not fully established.

corrections.v1: A reliable emulator ACK gate is not achievable by app changes
corrections.corrected: Removed. Whether an application or harness change could make emulator ACK testing reliable is not established either way.

corrections.v1: H3a host audio backend hypothesis refuted
corrections.corrected: Removing the host backend (-audio none) did not eliminate the faults, so the backend is not a necessary condition; this does not exclude every possible backend contribution.

corrections.v1: Producer not implicated; V03/2 faults began 1.8 s before injection (offset +0.44 s)
corrections.corrected: The ordering relies on one post-cohort clock probe without stated uncertainty; offsets differ by boot (null1 -1.04 to -1.09 s). It is an inference, not a measured certainty.

corrections.v1: Host input stayed OFF (double false before/after every trial)
corrections.corrected: Parent double-false checks passed before/after every trial, but in null1 V03/2 the producer read the emulator microphone state as enabled immediately after its lateness abort and failed closed (HOST_MICROPHONE_ENABLED_AFTER_ABORT); the parent end check read OFF.

protocolDeviations.planRule: Any guest stall/pre-recording UI failure: stop issuing audio trials; bounded recovery per handoff section 4.

triggeringTrial.layer: PRE_RECORDING_UI_FAILURE (targeted input injection refused: window not owned by the app; CAPTURE_DID_NOT_REACH_VISIBLE_RECORDING)

protocolDeviations.cause: The reviewed cohort helper had no status-based stop; it continued after any normal terminal parent record.
protocolDeviations.handling: All results retained unchanged; the four trials are labelled post-deviation and were run outside the frozen plan. The low-load cohort helper implements the stop rules explicitly.
